    git ... reset -q HEAD -- <the armed paths>

- **The armed set is not the reporting lanes files.** `I-0654` named one AJC Lean file; the same index also held a -16 on `scripts/axiom-frontier.lean` (the standing measurement record) and **176 lines across three AJCR worksheets** (`spec-dd-r.md` -87, `w5-t4-worksheet.md` -61, `protocol-concurrent-lanes.md` -28). DECIDED 2026-07-27: choose R1, coordinate twists, as the architecture-preserving widening. Declaration-level audits reject R2 as a much wider FinCoverData/support-principalization refactor and R3 as a replacement of the established divisor representation layer. p1-aut and the infinite-field fibre-avoidance branch are landed. The proposed in-place cert-relocalize refactor is rejected because every DivRepGlobalData classifier is fixed in pi; its replacement is the outer twist-atlas row, which retains each fixed-twist classifier and glues those charts on common divisor loci.
